name: Mercenary
blurb: The archetypal frontline Hunter — a durable melee bruiser built around sword-and-board and blunt weapons, trading sustained pressure for survivability.

name: Sorcerer
blurb: A ranged spellcaster that scales with Magical Increase, leaning on the staff to deal burst magical damage from a distance.

name: Blackarrow
blurb: A dedicated archer that controls space from afar with the bow, converting positioning and physical damage into safe, sustained DPS.

name: Shadowstrix
blurb: A high-mobility assassin built for daggers and dual blades — closes distance, opens with critical strikes, and disengages before retaliation lands.

name: Seer
blurb: A utility caster oriented around the catalyst and Healing Bonus, supporting the team through sustain and control rather than raw damage.

name: Withered Knight
blurb: A heavy two-handed greatsword specialist that trades speed for reach and poise, excelling at toughness-break and parry against tough targets.
